articles.title: New York judge declines to block Kalshi from operating in the state for now
articles.snippet: Judge Melissa Crane did not shut down Kalshi's operations in a hearing Monday, but did say she wanted both parties to present their full arguments in an expedited fashion.

articles.title: Bitcoin Rallies, Anthropic Sinks as Nvidia Surges 35% on Jensen Huang’s Return
articles.snippet: Nvidia’s comeback sent chip shares soaring and gave Bitcoin a lift after a punishing selloff. Anthropic, fresh from its record IPO, missed the party.

articles.title: Solana Meme Coin for Fiona the Hippo Raises $100K for Cincinnati Zoo Charity
articles.snippet: A meme coin honoring the Cincinnati Zoo's late pygmy hippo has sent its creator rewards to the zoo's nonprofit.
